description: A PIC X item that carries bytes rather than text: a status flag of 0x03, a region byte of 0x93, all 256 byte values in one item, and the two bytes an ASCII and an EBCDIC file pad with, declared by one encoding-override naming the group they sit in — beside a text key and a text name that are still read, trimmed and written as characters.
source: docs/layout/SPEC.md, "A byte is not a character, and such an item has no charset"; docs/ir/SPEC.md, "An item with no charset carries bytes, not characters"; docs/conformance/SPEC.md, "An item with no charset is a run of bytes as well"
